entities.summary: Benjamin Dube is a South African gospel recording artist who rose to fame in the early 80s. Over the years he has released several albums which have reached gold and platinum status in the South African music rankings. Dube is also a lead pastor and General Overseer of High Praise Centre Church in South Africa
